title: Netanyahu Orders IDF to Expand Gaza Territorial Control to 70% — Day 961
detail: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu announced on May 29, 2026 (Day 961) that he had directed the IDF to extend Israeli military control over 70% of the Gaza Strip, up from approximately 60% currently held. 'We're in possession of 60% of the Gaza Strip's territory. My directive is to move to 70%,' Netanyahu said, according to Bloomberg. The announcement marked a significant escalation of Israeli territorial ambitions and drew immediate international concern. Germany expressed unease at the Israeli expansion plan, with Berlin citing both international law implications and the humanitarian consequences for Gaza's 2.1 million displaced civilians now confined to less than a third of the territory. The UN Secretary-General's office called on Israel to halt military operations that deepen displacement. The expansion directive comes as ceasefire Phase 2 talks remain completely deadlocked over Hamas disarmament demands and the humanitarian crisis worsens, with 470,000 facing IPC Phase 5 catastrophic hunger. At the UN Security Council, the US has continued to shield Israel from binding resolutions as the death toll surpassed 74,000.

media.caption: Netanyahu orders IDF to expand territorial control to 70% of Gaza Strip as Germany expresses concern — May 29, 2026

title: Six More Palestinians Killed as IDF Strikes Continue Amid Deepening Humanitarian Crisis
detail: Israeli airstrikes continued across the Gaza Strip on May 29, 2026 (Day 961), killing at least six more Palestinians as the humanitarian crisis deepened. The Palestine Chronicle reported ongoing casualties amid continuing ceasefire violations, hunger, and siege conditions. Hamas has documented 3,005 ceasefire violations since the October 2025 agreement, with only 49,973 of the 135,600 mandated aid trucks having entered (36% compliance). The WSWS reported on May 29 that Israel is stepping up efforts to extend territorial control under cover of ongoing US-Iran negotiations. Cumulative Palestinian deaths in Gaza since October 7, 2023 have surpassed 74,000. The UN Security Council is deadlocked, with the US continuing to veto binding resolutions. Phase 2 ceasefire talks remain stalled over Hamas's refusal to disarm and Israel's refusal to commit to a permanent end to the war.

media.caption: UN warns Gaza risks permanent limbo as Israeli strikes continue and ceasefire phase 2 talks remain deadlocked — May 29, 2026
